audit: L2 independent timing and execution-cost audit A
scope: Frozen V8.0 formal replay; no L3, no parameter search, no production changes

adk_first_trade.reported_execution: 2015-08-27 CN close, per extract_dk_rebalances, using the previous result row's date and index close
adk_first_trade.assessment: The fee is attached to the first holding return interval ending 2015-08-28. This is an interval-end daily-return convention; it does not by itself prove final NAV is numerically wrong. The model assumes a signal computed from the 2015-08-27 final close can trade at that same close, which requires a separate executable-price validation.

subb_first_account_trade.assessment: Both account ledgers mark the Thursday signal pending and charge the next session opening trade. No same-day signal-to-open execution was found in these first events.

subb_first_all_etf_execution.caveat: The ETF execution price is post-listing, but the BTC signal's 160/260/390-session lookback still includes pre-IBIT UTC daily proxy observations.

subb_proxy_lookback_boundary.ema_memory: The 100-session EMA score is recursive and retains a decaying pre-IBIT proxy contribution beyond 2025-08-04 unless restarted with an explicit post-listing warmup.
subb_proxy_lookback_boundary.interpretation: 2024-01-12 is the first all-listed ETF full return day, not the first proxy-free B decision day.

subc_post_listing_scale_events.timing_assessment: Both decisions use prior-close volatility; the gold opening trade cost independently reconciles exactly to frozen open and close prices.

subc_annual_base_rebalance.source_policy: Annual close fee is explicitly calculated on base account weight turnover, at 0.1% of base turnover. The separate scale-transition fee is zero on both dates below; there is no same-day scale transition to double charge.
subc_annual_base_rebalance.scenario_formula: sum(abs(close_base_weight - pre_close_base_weight) * current_scale_by_asset) * 0.001, with equity assets using equity_scale, GLDM using gold_scale, others using 1
subc_annual_base_rebalance.assessment: The base-ledger cost arithmetic passes its documented rule. A single-account execution claim at the scaled gross exposures requires a separately specified and reconciled trading-cost model; the scenario differences are not automatically a bug in the stated paper model.

subc_timing_switch.assessment: PROD_USE_TIMING is false, so all monthly asset signals are one. Missing monthly timing-switch commissions are not an active V8.0 issue.

overall: Conditional L2 timing evidence: B T-close to T+1 adjusted-open and C scale transition examples pass; ADK assumes same-close signal and execution, with fee booked in the following close-to-close return row; proxy-free signal dates and full-scaled account costs remain outside current certification.
